description: This is a square, tufted ottoman with a leather finish. It features a contemporary design with a silver metal base and legs. The tufting creates a grid-like pattern on the top surface, giving it a classic yet modern aesthetic. The leather appears to have a slight sheen, suggesting a smooth texture. The overall construction looks sturdy and well-made, suitable for use as a footrest, extra seating, or even a makeshift coffee table.
